name: agentpilot
description: Prepare missing task/eval inputs and run configured AgentPilot experiments.

interface.longDescription: One entry: the current agent prepares missing task/evaluation inputs, then hands a ready environment to the configured AgentPilot runner. Formal runs need a compatible adapter, working evaluation and model/worker settings. Requires local file access and command execution.
